Thanks for the details — this is exactly what we need to scope the migration. I attached a preliminary capacity spreadsheet that maps token/sec to GPU counts under three model mixes (L, M, H).

Proposal (high level):
1) Phase 0 — Data & auth handoff (3 days): traffic sample, API keys, whitelisted IPs, and sample prompt sets.
2) Phase 1 — Bench validation (4 days): small-scale stress runs to validate kernel selection, batch behavior, and quantization profiles. We will run 2x and 3x burst windows.
3) Phase 2 — Production staging (7 days): mirror traffic (traffic shadowing) with prefix/KV cache warmup and throughputs at 0.5x, 1x, and 3x for progressive validation. Collect P95 latency, token/sec, and cost estimates.
4) Phase 3 — Cutover window (2 days): final switchover and monitored rollback period (24h).

Conservative timeline: 16 working days from data handoff to cutover. If NovaEdge can commit to a dry-run week we can shrink to ~10 working days.

Ask: please share a 48-hour tokenized traffic sample + two representative long-context prompts. Also confirm whether you need on-prem keying (KMS) or standard cloud KMS.

I’ll loop in Karthik for the acceptance criteria and Marissa on the commercial side.

On Fri, Mar 9, 2028 at 11:03 AM Camila Reyes wrote:
> I attached a preliminary capacity spreadsheet that maps token/sec to GPU counts under three model mixes (L, M, H).

Quick technical checklist / sizing matrix (draft):
- Acceptance criteria (Phase 1 & 2):
  * P95 latency <= 250ms at 1x baseline; <= 350ms at 3x burst
  * No more than 2% request error rate under stress window
  * KV cache hit-rate >= 60% after warmup window (we will instrument hit-rate by route)
- Sizing assumptions (model mix):
  * Mix L (lighter model): 1 A100 equiv per ~220 token/sec
  * Mix M: 1 A100 equiv per ~150 token/sec
  * Mix H (larger models / long context): 1 A100 equiv per ~85 token/sec (accounts for 2k token tails)
- Operational knobs to optimize cost/latency during test: continuous batching (max batch 64), token-penalty routing for extremely long prompts, prefix caching TTL 2h for repeated prompts
- Stress window plan:
  * Warmup: 2 hours of ramping from 0.25x to 1x (populate KV caches)
  * Full stress: 90-minute 3x sustained window; collect token/sec, GPU utilization, and latency heatmaps
  * Cooldown & rollback criteria defined (if P95 > 400ms or error rate > 5%)
- Cutover choreography:
  * Switch traffic to dedicated in regional slices (east1 then west1) with 30-minute observation windows and auto-fallback routing to hosted for the first 24h if threshold breaches

I’ve exported a CSV sizing matrix (sizing_matrix_v2.csv) with the mapping and cost implications. Camila / Marissa: confirm if NovaEdge wants the conservative or aggressive quantization profile for the final commit. Conservative retains FP16 kernels; aggressive uses 4-bit quant where verified.

-Karthik
Principal Applied ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: sizing_matrix_v2.csv
